description: This file handles the creation of a team via a checkout session, including validating the session, updating the database, and saving billing information. It also manages error handling and response formatting.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Main async function to handle team creation request, validate session, update database, and save billing info.

methods.name: getCheckoutSession
methods.description: Retrieves the Stripe checkout session by ID and expands the subscription data.

methods.name: validateCheckoutSession
methods.description: Checks if the checkout session payment status is 'paid'.

methods.name: getCheckoutSessionSubscription
methods.description: Extracts the subscription object from the checkout session, throws error if absent.

methods.name: getCheckoutSessionMetadata
methods.description: Parses and validates the metadata from the checkout session.
